amendments.summary: Clarified the missed-visit window from 7 to 5 days and raised the HbA1c ceiling from 9.0% to 9.5%.

changes.new: Hold if ALT is above 2x ULN.
changes.old: Hold if ALT is above 3x ULN.

amendments.summary: Raised the minimum age to 21, extended washout from 14 to 28 days, tightened the dose-hold threshold to ALT above 2x ULN, and extended fasting to 10 hours.
